blocks.text: Elevate your cottage-inspired living room or bedroom with the Realyn round end table, designed for those who love classic charm with everyday function. Its antiqued two-tone finish, chipped white base and distressed wood top pair beautifully with sofas, bed side table setups or as a small nightstand beside a reading chair. A shapely lower shelf provides convenient display space, while decorative cabriole legs bring timeless elegance to any home. Perfect as an end table, side table or narrow nightstand, it delivers durability and style for years to come.

items.label: TIMELESS COTTAGE DESIGN
items.value: Charming antiqued two-tone finish blends chipped white and distressed wood to elevate living room end tables or bed side table setups with warm, traditional style

items.label: QUALITY MATERIALS
items.value: Made of ash veneer, wood, engineered wood and cast resin components to deliver long-lasting durability whether used as a small nightstand, end table or side table in any room

items.label: VERSATILE FUNCTION
items.value: Works beautifully as a round end table, night stand, small side table or couch table, giving you flexible placement in bedrooms, living rooms or reading nooks

items.label: USEFUL LOWER SHELF
items.value: Fixed lower shelf provides extra storage for decor, books or essentials, helping keep bedroom end table or side table arrangements tidy and intentional

items.label: IDEAL SIZE
items.value: At 26" W x 26" D x 25.88" H, this narrow end table fits tight spaces while offering plenty of surface area, making it a smart choice as a night stand or side table in living room layouts
